input.manifest_yaml:
"components":
  - "id": "journal"
    "type": "platform"
    "platform": "aws-cloudfront"
    "config":
      "minimumProtocolVersion": "TLSv1.2_2021"
      "aliases":
        - "static-site-cdn-waf.example.com"
      "certificateDomain": "static-site-cdn-waf.example.com"
  - "id": "inbox"
    "type": "platform"
    "platform": "aws-guardduty"
    "config":
      "enabled": true
      "findingPublishingFrequency": "FIFTEEN_MINUTES"
      "s3DataSource": true
  - "id": "loader"
    "type": "platform"
    "platform": "aws-ecs-task-definition"
    "config":
      "cpu": "256"
      "memory": "512"
      "containerDefinitions":
        - "name": "app"
          "image": "ecs-fargate-alb-app-task:latest"
          "cpu": 256
          "memory": 512
          "portMappings":
            - "containerPort": 3000
              "protocol": "tcp"
  - "id": "kiosk"
    "type": "platform"
    "platform": "aws-cloudtrail"
    "config":
      "isMultiRegionTrail": true
      "enableLogFileValidation": true
      "includeGlobalServiceEvents": true
      "cloudWatchLogsEnabled": true
      "logRetentionDays": 90
"bindings": []
"policyPack": "Baseline"
